plugins.name: skills-pages-ci
plugins.description: Integrate skills-pages into a CI/CD pipeline so a skills repository is validated and its site and Claude Code marketplace are deployed to GitHub Pages or GitLab Pages on every push. Use when asked to automate publishing of a skills repo, add a pages workflow, or gate a deploy on skill checks.

plugins.name: skills-pages-cli
plugins.description: Use the skills-pages CLI (@nf3t/skills-pages) to turn an agent skills repository into a static site with install guides and Claude Code, oh-my-pi, OpenCode and pi marketplaces. Use when asked to publish, preview, build, validate or check a skills repo, or to write its marketplace.json files.
